text:
Ana (CS): quick weekly account-health sync for AstraClinic — following up on last week's support escalations. TL;DR: repeat 503s on /v1/generate, p95 latency up to ~1.9s during spikes, error_rate peaked ~2.8% during business hours, spend bumped ~18% due to retries. Need owners for action items and a customer update before EOD Fri.

Mike (SRE): I pulled the rollout and tracer logs. Autoscaler hit a cold-start gap when we had a short burst, and our fallback model routing failed for ~8min. Found this in datadog: `errors.count{service:inference,customer:astraclinic}.rollup(sum,60) > 0` with correlated 503 traces.

Kevin (Eng): I can take the routing fallback fix. Repro steps? sample request_id?

Mike (SRE): sample request IDs: req_0a3f2c, req_0a3f5d — attached traces. Repro is intermittent under burst; try `wrk` with 60 RPS for 3m against their model shard. Also seeing KV cache misses spike after autoscaler events.

Kevin (Eng): got it. I'll add a short circuit to fallback logic and increase min replicas for that model pool. Plan: branch `fix/astraclinic-fallback`, run canary, then promote. ETA: PR by Tue EOD, canary Wed morning.

Ana (CS): thanks. Customer-facing note draft: "We identified a routing edge case that caused temporary 503s during short capacity bursts. Engineering has a fix in progress; we expect canary Wed and full rollout after validation. We'll confirm once completed." Can someone own sending the update?

Julia (PM): I can own the customer update and renewal risk note. I'll sync with Ana after canary results. Suggest we mark renewal risk as "monitoring" not "at-risk" unless we see another repeat in next 2 weeks.

Kevin (Eng): action items I own: 1) PR with fallback fix (branch above) 2) increase min_replicas for AstraClinic pool (config change) 3) add a rollback script and test. I'll post PR link when ready.

Mike (SRE): action items I own: 1) run targeted load test for canary and verify KV cache warmup 2) update runbook with autoscaler cold-start mitigation steps 3) set short-term alert: `sum:inference.errors{customer:astraclinic}.rollup(sum,60) > 0` -> P2.

Ana (CS): owner for customer comms Julia, owner for engineering fixes Kevin, owner for infra validation Mike. Deadline: confirm canary outcome by Thu COB, customer note sent by Fri EOD.

Kevin (Eng): small note — before canary I'll add a debug flag so we can measure cache hit ratios without verbose logging. Query I'll run:```datadog
avg:trace.duration{service:inference,customer:astraclinic}.rollup(max,60)
avg:kv.cache.hit_rate{customer:astraclinic}.rollup(avg,60)
```

Mike (SRE): copying the on-call runbook change here: 1) if >3 consecutive 503 minutes -> escalate to eng oncall 2) add short-term increased min_replicas for burst windows 3) schedule cache warmup job after scale events.

Ana (CS): note for renewals: add a one-off credit for impacted billing window? sales typically asks for that. I'll confirm with finance.

OncallBot: Incident note created: INC-20240612-astraclinic-503. Assigned to Kevin (Eng) and Mike (SRE). Priority: P2.

Julia (PM): thanks all. I'll draft the email now and share for review. Can we have the PR link and canary results before 12:00 Wed?

Kevin (Eng): will try to get PR up by Tue 18:00 UTC. Canary results posted Wed 09:30 UTC.

Ana (CS): perfect — I'll block time for the customer update review Wed 10:00 UTC. 

Mike (SRE): I'll run a rehearsal load test Tue night against canary and paste results in this thread. :thumbsup:

Ana (CS): action summary for tracking (copy to playbook): [Kevin] eng fix + config change (PR by Tue), [Mike] infra validation + runbook + load test, [Julia] customer comms + renewal status, [Ana] billing follow-up. 

Kevin (Eng): noted. Adding owners to the Jira ticket now (PROD-4827).

Ana (CS): closing loop — please update this thread when each item is done. If any blocker, ping me or escalate. :eyes:

Mike (SRE): acknowledging, will update.

OncallBot: Reminder: next scheduled follow-up check-in Thu 16:00 UTC."
